description: This file implements PHP4 session management using the ADODB database abstraction library, including functions for session open, close, read, write, destroy, and garbage collection, with encryption support.

classes.name: MD5Crypt
classes.description: A class used for encrypting and decrypting session data.

methods.name: ADODB_Session_Key
methods.description: Creates an encryption key for crypted sessions based on a static key and session ID.

methods.name: adodb_sess_read
methods.description: Reads session data from the database, decrypting it.

methods.name: adodb_sess_write
methods.description: Encrypts and writes session data to the database.

methods.name: adodb_sess_destroy
methods.description: Deletes session data from the database.

methods.name: adodb_sess_gc
methods.description: Performs garbage collection of expired sessions.
